title: ¶The obedienie of wives vnto their husbandes.

segments.text:
AFter yt Eve was deceaved of ye serpēt / God said vnto her Genesis. iij. Thy lust or appetite shall pertayne vnto thy husbād & he shall rule the or raygne over the. God which created the womā knoweth what is in that weake vessell (as Peter calleth her) ād hath therfore put her vnder the obedience of her husband to rule her lustes and wantā appetites. Peter. j. Pet. iij. exhorteth wives to be in subiecciō vnto their husbandes / after the ensample of the holy wemē which in old tyme trusted in God / ād as Sara obeyed Abrahā and called him lorde. Which Sara before she was maryed / was Abrahās sister ād equall with him: but as sone as she was maryed was in subiecciō and became without cōparison inferior. For so is ye nature of wedlock by the ordinaūce of God It were moch better that oure wives folowid ye ēsample of the holy wemē of old tyme in obeyēge their husbādes / thē to worshippe thē with a Pater noster / an A•e & a Credo / or to sticke vp candels before their images. Paul Ephe. v. saith: wemen submitte your selves vnto your awne husbandes / as vnto ye lorde. For the husbāde is the wives heed evē as Christ is the heed of the cōgregaciō. Therfore as the cōgregaciō is in subiecciō to christ / like wise let wives be in subiecciō vnto their husbādes in all thīges. Let
ye womā therfore feare her husbād / as Paul saith in ye said place. For her husbād is vnto her in ye sted of god / y• she obeye hī & wayte ō his cōmaūdmētes. And his cōmaūdmētes are gods commaundmentes. If she therfore grudge agaynst him or resiste him she grudgeth agenste God and resisteth God.
